prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: production PNG controller-button sprite atlas for a Pokemon Stadium-style battle UI, not a mockup screenshot. Output 1536x1152 pixels, genuinely transparent alpha background. Exactly 12 isolated gamepad glyphs in a perfectly regular 4-column by 3-row grid of equal square cells. Every glyph centered in its cell, same optical size, with at least 64px empty transparent padding inside each cell. No visible grid, no headings, no watermarks, no surrounding controller, no labels outside buttons. Clean front-facing dark charcoal button caps with thin bright silver rims, slight bevel, bold very legible symbols, no perspective, no shadows outside caps. Designed to read at 16-24px. Row 3: four right analog stick direction prompts. Each is a round stick cap with small bold 'R' and one single prominent white arrow pointing respectively UP, RIGHT, DOWN, LEFT. The arrows must unmistakably indicate pushing the right stick, never pressing a face button. Row 2 column4 is a compact plus-shaped directional pad glyph. Xbox family: Row1 columns1-4 are circular A (green), B (red), X (blue), Y (yellow) face buttons. Row2 columns1-3 are wide rounded LB, RB, and a round MENU button with three white horizontal lines. Text on shoulder caps exactly 'LB' and 'RB'. Face letters very large.
